title: 楕円型手荷物受取コンベヤ
description: 空港や旅客ターミナルの受取エリアに置く楕円型手荷物コンベヤ。二つの直線区間と半円端を回る72枚の独立した厚い傾斜スラット、中央島、丸い外周カバーとバンパー、床支持足、前後の点検蓋を造形。荷物、搬入口、建物側の裏コンベヤは含まず、一周した受取台のみの一式1点です。ベルト搬送や設備制御は実装していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）4.318 × 0.745 × 2.518 m、9,664三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An oval baggage carousel for airport and passenger-terminal reclaim areas. Seventy-two separate thick inclined slats follow two straight runs and rounded ends around a central island, with a curved outer skirt/bumper, support feet and front/rear access panels. Luggage, feed opening and behind-wall conveyor are absent; this is one complete closed-loop reclaim unit. Belt transport and equipment controls are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 4.318 × 0.745 × 2.518 m; 9,664 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
